js: var t = document.getElementById('track'); var pos = document.getElementById('pos'); function upd(){ if(t && pos) pos.textContent = 'scrollLeft: ' + Math.round(t.scrollLeft) + 'px'; } if (t) { t.addEventListener('scroll', upd, { passive: true }); document.getElementById('btn-nudge').onclick = function(){ t.scrollBy({ left: 90, behavior: 'smooth' }); }; document.getElementById('btn-fling').onclick = function(){ t.scrollBy({ left: 340, behavior: 'smooth' }); }; document.getElementById('btn-reset-scroll').onclick = function(){ t.scrollTo({ left: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); }; upd(); }
expectedObservation: In mandatory mode, nudging +90px forces the scroll container to settle aligned to the amber scroll-padding guide line. In proximity mode, the viewport only snaps when resting near a snap edge; in none, it stops wherever the gesture ends.
